# Allen Mask
Partner at WestCap and Managing Partner of CoLab (WestCap's creative studio). Investor, operator, and creative based in Raleigh, North Carolina.

## Now
- Partner, WestCap: a global growth-equity firm; member of the Investment Committee. Focus is "operating equity," pairing capital with brand, creative, and operating support to drive outsized returns.
- Managing Partner, CoLab: the creative studio within WestCap that helps portfolio companies and select external clients build better brands, products, and stories.

## Background
- Airbnb: General Manager, Magical Trips (P&L owner) and first Product Marketing hire.
- Sonos: VP of Marketing and Chief of Staff to the CEO, through the company's IPO.
- Google: brand and product marketing across Google Play, Android, and YouTube.
- Goldman Sachs: Investment Banking Division.
- Forbes 30 Under 30 (Marketing & Advertising).
- University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill.

## Boards and service
Preply, Found, Hunt Club, SparkNC, and (past) the Santa Barbara Symphony.

## Also
Author of "Pour House," founder of RaiseYour.Bar, and a musician (releases as Allen Mask). Creative work: https://medium.com/@allenmask
